content.comment_body: I am comparing two PT100 sensors against a setpoint temperature in order to switch at the specified value. I know it’s possible to display the setpoint on the [product_name] operator device, but I’m wondering if it’s also possible to adjust the setpoint using the operator device.

There are several methods. The simplest approach: If you already display the setpoint on the [product_name] operator device, you can also modify it from there. To change a parameter, first select the relevant message text. Hold the ESC key for more than 2 seconds; you’ll see a black bar appear in an input/output field. Use the cursor up/down to navigate between fields. To change a field, press the OK button (on the operator device this is Enter). The black bar will become a blinking box—use cursor up/down to change the digit position, and left/right to switch character location. Once you’ve finished, press OK again to revert to the black bar. You can then use the cursor to move to another field or press ESC to exit.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to modify a temperature setpoint directly from the [product_name] operator panel, and instructions provided confirm this feature is supported. The steps outlined for making changes on the operator device show that the product allows for interactive parameter adjustments, although the process may feel complex due to multiple navigation and input actions required.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy and direct way to view and change the temperature setpoint from the [product_name] operator panel, preferably through a simple interface.
